## The Five Liturgical Confessions

<div style="background: #0a180a; border: 1px solid #1a5c1a; padding: 1.5rem; border-radius: 6px; margin: 1.5rem 0;">

  <form id="confession-form">

        <option value="25">f1: 1 to 2: A temporary lapse of atmospheric discipline. (-25 Debt)</option>
        <option value="55">f2: 3 to 5: Habitual leisure transit. (-55 Debt)</option>
        <option value="90">f3: 6 to 10: Chronic airborne defiance. (-90 Debt)</option>
        <option value="140">f4: More than 10: I treated the stratosphere as personal exhaust. (-140 Debt)</option>

        <option value="110">m4: Total caloric carnivory (At every meal). (-110 Debt)</option>

    <!-- 4. AI -->

      <p style="font-size: 0.8rem; color: #8cb88c; margin-top: 0;">Hyperscale compute drained the rivers before the reactors melted. Every prompt boiled freshwater.</p>

        <option value="0">a0: Zero. My thoughts are manual, slow, and human. (+0 Debt)</option>

<script>
function calculateDebt() {
  const f = parseInt(document.getElementById('q-flights').value);
  const c = parseInt(document.getElementById('q-car').value);
  const m = parseInt(document.getElementById('q-meat').value);
  const a = parseInt(document.getElementById('q-ai').value);
  const d = parseInt(document.getElementById('q-devices').value);
  const surrenderText = document.getElementById('q-surrender').options[document.getElementById('q-surrender').selectedIndex].text;
  
  const baseDebt = 100;
  const penalty = f + c + m + a + d;
  const total = -(baseDebt + penalty);
  
  document.getElementById('res-penalty').innerText = `-${penalty} Carbon Credits`;
  document.getElementById('res-total').innerText = `${total} Carbon Credits`;
  document.getElementById('res-surrender').innerText = surrenderText.split('(')[0].trim();
  
  document.getElementById('passport-preview').style.display = 'block';
  document.getElementById('passport-preview').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
}
</script>

## Dress Code & Sanctuary Safety

* **Approved Aesthetic:** Dystopian utility chic, rewilding workwear, earth tones (moss green, soot black, soil brown), and natural biological fibers. Synthetic fast-fashion fabrics are strictly mocked.
* **The Universal Safe-Word ("OZONE"):** Speaking **"OZONE"** immediately pauses all roleplay. All wardens, performers, and participants must drop character, step back, and assist you.
* **Observer Wristbands:** Guests who wish to enjoy the music, cocktails, and dancing without engaging in interrogation, carbon audits, or chores may request an **Observer Wristband** at the door.
* **The Sanctuary Safe Zone:** The library on the second floor is designated as a permanent, non-theatrical Safe Zone.
